name: fincore-cypress-suite
description: FinCore Bank — banking QA practice app with an end-to-end + API test suite built in Cypress

scripts.api:test: newman run postman/fincore-api.postman_collection.json -e postman/fincore-local.postman_environment.json --env-var baseUrl=http://localhost:3000 -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export newman/report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "FinCore API - Newman report"
scripts.api:test:ci: newman run postman/fincore-api.postman_collection.json -e postman/fincore-local.postman_environment.json --env-var baseUrl=http://localhost:3000 -r cli,htmlextra,junit --reporter-htmlextra-export newman/report.html --reporter-junit-export newman/results/newman-results.xml

author: Hathim Al Ghifari
